sections.heading: What is trending: “microsoft”
paragraphs: “microsoft” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for PL (snapshot taken 2026-11-07T14:00:53+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 1,000 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from AP News, Reuters, The Guardian. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “Activists break into building site of Microsoft datacentre in Amsterdam” — The Guardian
“Protesters break into Microsoft data center site in Amsterdam as Europe’s backlash spreads” — AP News
“Activists breach Microsoft data centre construction site as protests spread in Europe” — Reuters

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Sat, 7 Nov 2026 03:00:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-07T14:00:53+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-07T14:01:42+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.

faq.a: Google's Trending Now feed links the spike to coverage from AP News, Reuters, The Guardian. Google reports at least 1,000 searches in PL as of the feed snapshot. This is a published lower bound, not an exact count.
